dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「病院の検診、いよいよ今日ですね」
dialogues.en: As Moe spoke softly, I nodded vaguely.
dialogues.text: As Moe spoke softly, I nodded vaguely.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en:
If my leg was healed, Moe-sempai would have no reason to be
here. That thought made me feel hesitant to go to the
hospital.
dialogues.text:
If my leg was healed, Moe-sempai would have no reason to be
here. That thought made me feel hesitant to go to the
hospital.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「お医者さんが、大丈夫と言ってくれるといい
　です」
にこやかに話す萌先輩に、俺は｛あいまい／曖昧｝に｛うなず／頷｝く。

足が治ったら、萌先輩がここにいる理由がなく
なる。そう思うと、病院へ行くのが｛ためら／躊躇｝われた。
dialogues.en:
I know it doesn't change anything, but I want to go as late
as possible.
dialogues.text:
I know it doesn't change anything, but I want to go as late
as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「学園を休んでいくんですか？」

無駄なあがきと知りつつ、少しでも後にのばし
たかった。

萌先輩の笑顔を見ながら、それまでに、また足
が痛くなればいいのにと思うのだった……。
dialogues.en:
As I watched Moe-sempai's smiling face, I hoped my leg
wasn't completely healed yet......
dialogues.text:
As I watched Moe-sempai's smiling face, I hoped my leg
wasn't completely healed yet......

dialogues.jp:
とうとう、検診の日が来た。異常が無ければ、
萌先輩はこの家から出て行ってしまう。

少しでも萌先輩と過ごしていたくて、俺は学園
まで一緒に歩いていくことにした。検診は放課
後に行くとしよう。
dialogues.en: "I hope the doctor will tell you everything's fine."
dialogues.text: "I hope the doctor will tell you everything's fine."
